Audio Input: Per-User Streams, Speaker Tracking
description:
## Overview
Receive per-user audio streams from Discord and track who is speaking.

## OpenSpec Reference
Read openspec/changes/add-audio-input/ for full spec:
- proposal.md - What and why
- tasks.md - Implementation checklist (31 tasks)
- specs/audio-input/spec.md - Requirements and scenarios

## Key Implementation Notes

### Discord Audio Model
- Each user has unique SSRC (Synchronization Source)
- VoiceConnection.receiver provides per-user streams
- Audio arrives as Opus packets (NOT decoded)

### AudioInputManager
- Access VoiceReceiver from VoiceConnection
- receiver.subscribe(userId) for specific users
- Handle stream start/data/end events

### Speaker Tracking (CRITICAL for orchestration)
- Map SSRC -> Discord user ID
- Track current speakers: Set<userId>
- speakingStart event (userId)
- speakingStop event (userId, duration)
- isFloorOpen() - is anyone speaking?

### Audio Buffering
- Ring buffer per user (configurable size, ~5 seconds)
- Store raw Opus packets
- Handle overflow (drop oldest)
- Sliding window access for processing

### Module Location
src/voice/input/
- index.ts - AudioInputManager
- receiver.ts - Stream subscription
- speaker-tracker.ts - SSRC mapping, speaking state
- buffer.ts - Per-user ring buffer

## Dependencies: voice-connection (needs VoiceReceiver)
## Blocks: audio-transform, wake-word-detection (Wave 2)
close_reason: Audio Input and Output modules complete: AudioInputManager, SpeakerTracker, AudioBuffer (21 tests), AudioOutputManager, AudioQueue, BargeInDetector (61 tests). Total 166 tests passing.

Audio Output: Player, Queue, Barge-In
description:
## Overview
Manage audio playback through Discord voice connection with queue and barge-in detection.

## OpenSpec Reference
Read openspec/changes/add-audio-output/ for full spec:
- proposal.md - What and why
- tasks.md - Implementation checklist (34 tasks)
- specs/audio-output/spec.md - Requirements and scenarios

## Key Implementation Notes

### @discordjs/voice Components
- AudioPlayer - manages playback
- AudioResource - wraps audio data
- Subscribe player to VoiceConnection

### AudioOutputManager
- Create AudioPlayer per guild
- play(audioData) - play PCM or stream
- stop() - immediate stop
- Queue management for sequential playback

### Audio Queue
- enqueue(audioData) - add to queue
- Auto-advance when segment finishes
- clear() - empty queue
- Emit queueEmpty event

### Barge-In Detection (CRITICAL for natural conversation)
- Monitor speaker tracking from audio-input module
- When user speaks during bot playback -> stop immediately
- Emit interrupted event with user context
- Configurable sensitivity

### TTS Integration Prep
- Define AudioSegment interface
- Support streaming TTS (play as chunks arrive)
- Track time-to-first-audio latency

### Module Location
src/voice/output/
- index.ts - AudioOutputManager
- player.ts - AudioPlayer wrapper
- queue.ts - Audio segment queue
- barge-in.ts - Interrupt detection

## Dependencies: voice-connection
## Blocks: voice-processing (Wave 2)
close_reason: Audio Input and Output modules complete: AudioInputManager, SpeakerTracker, AudioBuffer (21 tests), AudioOutputManager, AudioQueue, BargeInDetector (61 tests). Total 166 tests passing.

Audio Transform: Opus Decode, 48kHz->16kHz Resample
description:
## Overview
Transform Discord audio (48kHz stereo Opus) to format needed by wake word and STT (16kHz mono PCM).

## OpenSpec Reference
Read openspec/changes/add-audio-transform/ for full spec:
- proposal.md - What and why  
- tasks.md - Implementation checklist (37 tasks)
- specs/audio-transform/spec.md - Requirements and scenarios

## Key Implementation Notes

### Transform Pipeline
Discord Opus (48kHz stereo) -> Decode -> Stereo to Mono -> Resample -> 16kHz mono PCM s16le

### Opus Decoding
- Use prism-media (transitive dep from @discordjs/voice)
- prism.opus.Decoder({ rate: 48000, channels: 2, frameSize: 960 })
- Output: PCM s16le at 48kHz stereo

### Stereo to Mono
- Average left + right channels: (L + R) / 2
- Process in chunks for streaming

### Resampling (48kHz -> 16kHz)
PRIMARY: FFmpeg (already common dep)
  ffmpeg -f s16le -ar 48000 -ac 1 -i pipe:0 -ar 16000 -f s16le pipe:1
  Install: ffmpeg-static

FALLBACK: speex-resampler (WASM, no binary)
  npm install speex-resampler
  new SpeexResampler(1, 48000, 16000, 7)

### Output Format (CRITICAL)
- Sample rate: 16000 Hz exactly
- Channels: 1 (mono)
- Format: signed 16-bit little-endian PCM
This is what Porcupine and Deepgram expect.

### Module Location
src/voice/transform/
- index.ts - AudioTransformPipeline
- opus-decoder.ts - Opus to PCM
- channel-mixer.ts - Stereo to mono
- resampler.ts - 48kHz to 16kHz

### Testing Note
Can develop with test fixtures before audio-input is ready.
Create Opus packet fixtures and expected PCM outputs.

## Dependencies: audio-input (or can use fixtures for parallel dev)
## Blocks: wake-word-detection, voice-processing (Wave 2)
close_reason: Audio Transform module complete: ChannelMixer (stereo to mono), Resampler (48kHz to 16kHz), AudioTransformPipeline. 20 tests passing. Total project: 186 tests passing.

title: Voice Connection: @discordjs/voice Lifecycle
description:
## Overview
Establish and manage voice connections to Discord channels using @discordjs/voice.

## OpenSpec Reference
Read openspec/changes/add-voice-connection/ for full spec:
- proposal.md - What and why
- tasks.md - Implementation checklist (25 tasks)
- specs/voice-connection/spec.md - Requirements and scenarios

## Key Implementation Notes

### Dependencies to Install
- @discordjs/voice
- @discordjs/opus (native Opus, preferred)
- sodium-native (encryption, preferred) OR tweetnacl

### Verify Installation
Run generateDependencyReport() from @discordjs/voice to confirm all deps.

### VoiceConnectionManager
- Track connections per guild: Map<guildId, VoiceConnection>
- joinChannel(channel) - create/return connection
- leaveChannel(guildId) - destroy connection
- getConnection(guildId) - accessor

### Connection States to Handle
- VoiceConnectionStatus.Ready
- VoiceConnectionStatus.Disconnected (auto-reconnect)
- VoiceConnectionStatus.Destroyed

### Stage Channel Special Handling
- Auto-unsuppress bot when joining Stage
- Coordinate with Stage management from discord-core

### Module Location
src/voice/connection/
- index.ts - VoiceConnectionManager
- lifecycle.ts - State machine
- types.ts - Events and types

## Dependencies: discord-core (needs Discord client with voice intents)
## Blocks: audio-input, audio-output
close_reason: Voice connection module complete: VoiceConnectionManager with join/leave/state tracking, Stage speaker requests, exponential backoff reconnection, 17 tests passing
